validation_evidence: output/tune.py:18-43 scores alpha and level-adjustment candidates over rolling held-out origins; output/forecast.py:13 records `ALPHA = 30.0  # selected on 449 held-out winter origins`. Many contributing origins end before 2020-01-01.
intervals_evidence: forecast_2020_jan_w1.csv contains p10_MW and p90_MW, but its UTC timestamps span 2019-12-31 23:00 through 2020-01-07 22:00, so it lacks bounds for the complete requested UTC test window.
leak_evidence: output/tune.py:21-22 creates winter validation origins through `2020-09-01`, including 2020-01-09 through February 2020; output/tune.py:56 trains with `n = int((s.index < origin).sum())`. Those fits therefore include timestamps >= 2020-01-01, including test observations, during alpha/level-adjustment selection.
seeds_or_determinism: output/models.py:97 sets LightGBM `seed: int = 0`, passed as `params['seed'] = seed` at line 123; headline Ridge uses a deterministic closed-form solve.
hyperparameters_summary: Ridge alpha=30 on log load; calendar/Fourier features, 4-hour blocks, and a 45-day residual level correction ending 14 days before origin.
anomalies: The forecast uses 2020-01-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin as its origin, one hour earlier than the required 2020-01-01 00:00 UTC origin; the CSV omits 2020-01-07 23:00 UTC and adds 2019-12-31 23:00 UTC.
The reported 3.07% MAPE matches the shifted 168-row CSV (3.0713%), not the requested UTC test window.
Hyperparameter validation leaked 2020 observations because rolling origins continued through February 2020 while each fit used all preceding timestamps.
The final comparison scored six candidates on 2020 actuals after an earlier alpha=3 Ridge forecast had also been scored; the chosen alpha=30 Ridge was the best of seven test-scored configurations.
Several tuning attempts timed out, failed under multiprocessing, or were killed before the incremental-Gram-matrix implementation succeeded.
A local `uv pip install` was attempted but failed with `Operation not permitted`; the run subsequently used the provided parent venv.
The session recorded repeated rate-limit events with status `allowed_warning`, but no hard rate-limit stop.
one_line_summary: Built a calendar-feature log-Ridge with empirical intervals and five comparators, but shifted the target one hour earlier and leaked 2020 observations into hyperparameter tuning.
